name: Accessor
brief: Utility class for traversing and inspecting paint trees

members.name: id
members.brief: Generate a unique hash ID from a string name (DJB2 hash).

members.name: set
members.signature: set(paint: Paint, callback: (paint: Paint) => boolean): void
members.brief: Traverse the scene tree of a paint and invoke a callback on the paint and each of its descendants. The callback receives the correctly typed Paint subclass (Shape, Scene, Picture, or Text). Return false from the callback to stop traversal early.

params.name: paint
params.description: The root paint node to traverse, typically a Picture or Scene

params.name: callback
params.description: Called for the root and each descendant paint. Return false to stop.

members.name: name
members.brief: Retrieve the original name string for a given ID.
members.returns: The corresponding name, or null if not found or unavailable
